default_rule: A validator or validation-like script is not a current gate merely because it exists. Current execution authority requires explicit registration here.

current_validators.purpose: AIOC canonical authority, workflow, validator, runtime-state and stale-selector health enforcement.

cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc.exception_rule: Only scripts explicitly listed in current_validators have current gate authority; filename pattern matches do not grant authority.

current_validation_core.purpose: Execute governed validation profiles with preflight and compact diagnostics.
Verify runner, toolchain, checkout and workspace contract without persistent host mutation.
Generate deterministic receipts and lane-specific evidence.
Compare deterministic Linux/Windows receipts on the exact candidate head.
Machine-enforce application workflow/selector/work-order repository-health invariants on the repository-attached self-hosted Linux runner.

current_capability_exceptions.purpose: Deterministically construct the exact Internal Alpha successor ZIP on both self-hosted platforms.
Verify exact package identity, boundaries and owner-approval state for the successor ZIP.

current_compatible_manual_checks.purpose: Manual lightweight runner smoke only; not a feature completion gate.

historical_inert_patterns: tools/validation_core/validate_*.py except explicitly registered current validators
historical tranche-specific tests invoked only by CRS-retired workflows
cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app.execution_rule: New or resumed production work uses a reviewed thin Validation Core profile by default. A historical feature validator may participate only after explicit current-lifecycle review and registration or a documented capability exception.
cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app.capability_exception_rule: A registered capability exception is bounded to its named work item and must be retired when that work item completes or is superseded. It does not become generic validation authority.

lifecycle_assumption_findings.finding: Historical A2/PPIA assertions using these states are not current project-state prerequisites. Dynamic task-capsule vocabulary may remain, but later lifecycle work cannot be blocked by a sealed earlier-stage expectation.

Application/package final validation remains self-hosted and Validation-Core governed. The only registered generic hosted execution is the bounded AIOC governance-health exception because AIOC has no repository-attached self-hosted runner.

lifecycle_assumption_findings.pattern: fixed historical branch, PR, tranche or stage state
lifecycle_assumption_findings.finding: Such assertions remain provenance only unless explicitly reclassified into a current gate.
